show.description: A broken engagement, a public dowry humiliation, and a marriage decided within hours, Neha never imagined her life would change so drastically. Forced into a sudden wedding with Rohan, who claims to be poor, she enters a relationship built on misunderstandings and ego. But as secrets unfold, she discovers he is actually the city’s most powerful billionaire. Will this marriage turn into true love?
